title: Recovering Black-Box Point Cloud Models from Pose Shifts via Derivative-Free Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.34850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Point cloud models are increasingly deployed through score-only black-box interfaces. Under this access model, test-time rotations outside the training distribution can substantially degrade performance. Although existing mitigations such as equivariant retraining and gradient-based adaptation are effective, they are infeasible without access to model weights or gradients. To address this limitation, we propose CanDO, a test-time canonicalization method that recovers lost performance using only forward queries. Specifically, CanDO searches for an input transformation that maximizes model confidence and uses derivative-free optimization to perform this search without gradients. We further identify three conditions for successful recovery: a training augmentation gap, an accuracy-aligned confidence surrogate, and global search over a multi-modal objective. Across multiple architectures and benchmarks, CanDO recovers 76% of the oracle gap

translated_title: 基于无导数优化的黑盒点云模型位姿偏移恢复方法
translated_abstract: 点云模型越来越多地通过仅提供分数的黑盒接口进行部署。在这种访问模式下，测试时超出训练分布的旋转会显著降低模型性能。尽管现有的缓解方法（如等变重训练和基于梯度的自适应方法）是有效的，但在无法访问模型权重或梯度的情况下这些方法不可行。为解决这一局限，我们提出了CanDO，一种仅使用前向查询即可恢复性能损失的测试时规范化方法。具体而言，CanDO搜索能够最大化模型置信度的输入变换，并使用无导数优化在无梯度的情况下执行该搜索。我们进一步确定了成功恢复的三个条件：训练数据增强差距、与准确率对齐的置信度代理指标，以及在多峰目标函数上的全局搜索。在多个架构和基准测试中，CanDO恢复了76%的oracle理想差距。
tldr: 提出CanDO方法，仅通过黑盒前向查询结合无导数优化搜索最优输入变换，即可在测试时恢复点云模型因位姿偏移而损失的性能。
en_tdlr: CanDO recovers lost performance of black-box point cloud models under pose shifts by using derivative-free optimization to search for input transformations that maximize model confidence, requiring only forward queries.
